01A rather tricky rainwater tank installation awaited us during the summer holidays in Písek, South Bohemia.

A rather tricky rainwater tank installation awaited us during the summer holidays in Písek, South Bohemia. We were approached by a homeowner with limited space in the garden who needed a tank for rainwater to water ornamental trees and shrubs and the lawn.

After surveying the site, we picked the most suitable spot and chose an appropriate type of tank to match. In terms of dimensions, the best fit was the FLAT 3000 L tank from the Czech manufacturer Elkoplast.

One unwelcome fact was that machinery could not get onto the plot, so we dug the excavations by hand, which was very demanding. We set the tank on a bedding layer of sandy gravel and backfilled around it with the same material.

02The safety overflow leads into the local public storm sewer, which runs right alongside the plot.

The safety overflow leads into the local public storm sewer, which runs right alongside the plot.
